name: cyber-accountant
description: C++20 REST API template — Drogon + libpqxx + redis-plus-plus + Kafka + observability
$comment: libsodium and libcurl come from the OS (apt: libsodium-dev, libcurl4-openssl-dev) — vcpkg's libsodium port fails to build on arm64-linux. inja is fetched header-only via CMake FetchContent (see CMakeLists.txt). Both choices keep the docker build green on x86_64 and arm64. pugixml is test-only (tests/unit/test_fno910_xml.cpp) — it independently parses Tax::Fno910::build_xml's hand-rolled string output to verify well-formedness; production code (src/tax/FnoXml.hpp, src/tax/Fno910.hpp) has no XML-library dependency, see their file headers for why (no official XSD to validate against — see P2 task-7-brief.md Step 1).
